name: StackWhatIf
description: Preview or apply an Azure Deployment Stack, and attach the result for the What-If build tab to read.
helpMarkDown: Runs `Microsoft.Resources/deploymentStacksWhatIfResults` against ARM and files the raw response as a build attachment, plus a sidecar manifest that is written even when the run fails. [Documentation](https://github.com/mfclay/azure-devops-extensions/tree/main/bicep-whatif)
author: mfclay

inputs.name: operation
inputs.label: Operation

options.validate: Validate the stack without deploying it

inputs.helpMarkDown: What-if, create and validate read the same inputs and take the same code path to ARM, so a preview cannot disagree with the deploy it previews. Defaults to `whatIf`: a step that leaves this out never deploys.

inputs.name: ConnectedServiceName
inputs.label: Azure Resource Manager connection
inputs.helpMarkDown: Service principal (secret), workload identity federation, or managed identity. Certificate-based service principals are not supported.

inputs.name: scope
inputs.label: Scope
inputs.helpMarkDown: Where the stack lives. Stacks exist at these three scopes only.

inputs.name: subscriptionId
inputs.label: Subscription id
inputs.helpMarkDown: Defaults to the service connection's subscription.

inputs.name: resourceGroupName
inputs.label: Resource group
inputs.helpMarkDown: The resource group the stack lives in. It must already exist.

inputs.name: managementGroupId
inputs.label: Management group id
inputs.helpMarkDown: The id of the management group the stack lives in, not its display name.

inputs.name: stackId
inputs.label: Stack id
inputs.helpMarkDown: The logical id, e.g. `network`. Used as the attachment name and as the tab's filter key. Not the Azure resource name unless they happen to match — see **Stack name**.

inputs.name: stackName
inputs.label: Deployment stack name
inputs.helpMarkDown: The Azure resource name of the stack, e.g. `app-network`. Defaults to **Stack id**.

inputs.name: templateFile
inputs.label: Template file
inputs.helpMarkDown: A `.bicep` whose `targetScope` matches **Scope**, or a compiled ARM `.json`. Required unless **Parameters file** is a `.bicepparam`, which names its own template with `using`.

inputs.name: parametersFile
inputs.label: Parameters file
inputs.helpMarkDown: A `.bicepparam` or a JSON parameters file. A `.bicepparam` is compiled in one pass that yields both the template and the parameter values, which is what makes secret redaction reliable.

inputs.name: parameters
inputs.label: Inline parameters
inputs.helpMarkDown: A JSON object of parameter name to value, e.g. `{"sku": "Standard"}`, laid over **Parameters file**. A `@secure()` parameter set here is redacted from the payload like one set in the file; pass its value from a secret variable.

inputs.name: location
inputs.label: Location
inputs.helpMarkDown: Where the stack — and, for a what-if, the transient result resource — lives. Not used at resource-group scope, where both take the group's location.

inputs.name: actionOnUnmanageResources
inputs.label: Action on unmanaged resources
inputs.helpMarkDown: What happens to a resource the stack stops managing. An input to what-if, not just to the deploy: it decides whether a resource dropped from the template is previewed as **Detach** or as **Delete**.

inputs.name: actionOnUnmanageResourceGroups
inputs.label: Action on unmanaged resource groups
inputs.helpMarkDown: What happens to a resource group the stack stops managing. A resource-group stack cannot manage one.

inputs.name: actionOnUnmanageManagementGroups
inputs.label: Action on unmanaged management groups
inputs.helpMarkDown: What happens to a management group the stack stops managing. Only a management-group-scope stack can manage one.

inputs.name: denySettingsApplyToChildScopes
inputs.label: Apply deny settings to child scopes

inputs.name: denySettingsExcludedActions
inputs.label: Excluded actions
inputs.helpMarkDown: Space-, comma- or newline-separated management operations excluded from the lock.

inputs.name: denySettingsExcludedPrincipals
inputs.label: Excluded principals
inputs.helpMarkDown: Up to five Entra principal object ids excluded from the lock.

inputs.name: retentionInterval
inputs.label: Result retention
inputs.helpMarkDown: ISO 8601. The service enforces one to three hours and rejects anything longer at run time, whatever the documentation says.

inputs.name: deleteWhatIfResult
inputs.label: Delete the what-if result when done
inputs.helpMarkDown: Stack what-if creates a persistent subscription-scope resource that counts toward that scope's limits. Leave this on; retention is the backstop, not the mechanism.

inputs.name: bicepVersion
inputs.label: Bicep version
inputs.helpMarkDown: Pinned on purpose. Compiler output changes across versions, and every consumer's what-if should compile identically. A `bicep` already on PATH is deliberately ignored.

inputs.name: layer
inputs.label: Layer
inputs.helpMarkDown: The deployment layer, recorded in the sidecar and used to group the tab's stack filter. Derived from a leading number in the template file name (`05-workload-stack.bicep` → 5) when not set.

inputs.name: resultName
inputs.label: What-if result name
inputs.helpMarkDown: Defaults to `whatif-<stackId>-<Build.BuildId>`, which is what keeps two concurrent builds from colliding on the same resource.

inputs.name: tags
inputs.label: Tags
inputs.helpMarkDown: A JSON object of tag name to string value, set on the stack and on the transient what-if result, which a tag policy would otherwise deny.

inputs.name: validationLevel
inputs.label: Validation level

options.provider: Provider — the resource providers validate, with RBAC checks

inputs.helpMarkDown: Leave unset for the service's default.

inputs.name: maskedOutputs
inputs.label: Masked outputs
inputs.helpMarkDown: Comma-separated output names. Every output of a create is set as an output variable of the same name; these are also masked in the log and redacted from the attached payload.

inputs.name: outputPath
inputs.label: Output directory
inputs.helpMarkDown: Where the payload, sidecar and summary are written before being attached. Defaults to a temporary directory. Point it at a staging directory to publish them as a pipeline artifact too.

inputs.name: publishSummary
inputs.label: Publish a markdown summary
inputs.helpMarkDown: Also attach a `Distributedtask.Core.Summary` roll-up, which renders on the build summary page without this extension's tab.
